title: IntelEngine — NPC Autonomy & Faction Politics
tagline: Give Skyrim’s NPCs agency—tasks, schedules, autonomous stories, and faction politics.
description:
IntelEngine gives Skyrim's NPCs the ability to act autonomously through SkyrimNet. NPCs can travel, deliver messages, fetch or escort people, schedule meetings and tasks, spread gossip, pursue personal storylines, and participate in an evolving faction-politics system.

Originally created by **Galanx**. Release 3.8 was developed by **PhospheneOverdrive** and **Galanx** in the official galanx repositories (IntelEngine-GamePlugin and IntelEngine-NativePlugin), with a natural-language time parser by **Lanosity**.

Release **3.8** makes NPCs far more dependable: stuck NPCs recover out of your sight, tasks finish across cells, visits end on their own, and an NPC finishes their sentence before setting off. IntelEngine now works with SkyrimNet's own dashboard: its settings are on SkyrimNet's plugin settings page, and running tasks show on the Package Manager page, where Remove cancels them. With **Magelight UI**, the Allow/Deny, door-knock and quest-offer prompts open as Magelight popups. Faction politics gets war rules, truces that hold and an optional, experimental Political Engine bridge (off by default). Every setting now has one plain-language name in the MCM, the dashboard and SkyrimNet's page.

⚠️ **Upgrading from a pre-3.6 save? Convert it before loading with 3.8.** Saves already on 3.6 or 3.7 and fresh games don't need conversion. See the FAQ included in the download for instructions. Windows Defender may flag the bundled converter as a false positive; it is being reported to Microsoft. IntelEngine settings now belong to the installation, not to one save: the first time an older save loads, its settings are written to the shared settings file.

3.8 tested on **Skyrim SE/AE 1.6.1170**. 1.7.104 and **VR 1.4.15 should work** but were not retested for 3.8. Skyrim 1.5.97 partly tested by users. Use the matching versions of **SKSE and Address Library**.

**Have issues?** Report them on the IntelEngine-GamePlugin GitHub issues page.

**Requires SkyrimNet Beta 27 or newer. Not compatible with Beta 26 or earlier.** The Package Manager row needs a SkyrimNet build with the package manager; older builds skip it. Optional: Magelight UI 1.7.1+ for the dashboard and popups.
author: phospheneoverdrive
changelog:
# IntelEngine 3.8.0

**New**
- IntelEngine's settings are on SkyrimNet's plugin settings page, kept in sync with the MCM and the dashboard. Settings now belong to your install, not one save.
- Running tasks show on SkyrimNet's Package Manager page; Remove cancels them.
- With Magelight UI, the Allow/Deny, door-knock and quest-offer prompts are Magelight popups (keys 1-3, gamepad). No answer within 20 seconds is a deny.
- Times in plain words: "in 2 hours", "tomorrow at 6", "at dusk" (time parser by Lanosity).
- Director: a form per story type, Generate fills only the type you picked, and required fields are checked before you send.
- Politics: choose which factions may go to war (`war_allowed:` in factions.yaml); ended wars become truces; big news reaches every NPC.
- Optional Political Engine support, off by default and experimental.

**Better**
- Stuck NPCs recover out of your sight, and other mods' follow or wait orders survive a task.
- Tasks finish across cells: unseen deliveries are reported back, and NPCs who arrive unseen end up inside the building.
- NPCs finish their sentence before they leave, and the inn's bard (or his audience) can be sent on a task.
- Visits end on their own: while you talk and a little after, six game hours at most, or when you walk away.
- One plain name per setting in the MCM, the dashboard and SkyrimNet's page.

**Fixed**
- Assassins and spawned soldiers no longer turn on you; brawl survivors are cleaned up.
- Story NPCs no longer get stuck arriving or speak from the floor below.
- Settings that showed the wrong value (NPC-to-NPC switches, sliders, defaults); two settings that did nothing were removed.
- An automatic story no longer overwrites a running one.

Install the whole package over 3.7.x. Requires SkyrimNet Beta 27+. Saves from before 3.6 still need the converter (see the FAQ).

Credits: developed by Gerkinfeltser & Galanx. Natural-language time parser by Lanosity.
